build_hrformer_backbone: build an HRFormer backbone model with configurable stages, window sizes, and attention heads for dense prediction
create_hrformerblock: create an HRFormerBlock with local window self-attention and cross FFN for transformer-based feature extraction
build_localwindowselfattention: build a LocalWindowSelfAttention module with window-based MSA and optional padding mask for short-range attention
create_crossffn: create a CrossFFN module with depthwise convolution and layer normalization for cross-feature feed-forward processing
